# Sample Handbook

This sample document exercises the Markdown chunker. It is intentionally short.

## Installation

Install the engine with the standard library only. No third party packages are required for BM25 retrieval.

## Usage

知识库使用说明：本工具把本地文档切分成块，用 BM25 排序后返回片段。

- 第一项：纯标准库即可运行。
- 第二项：可选向量检索。

## 附录

> Call `python engine/kb_engine.py` and speak NDJSON on stdin.
